areas.name: Secondary/technical education
areas.reason: Only a minor education-sector financial-management component; one indicator covers a narrow slice of school management; tiny resource share and low impact.

areas.name: Social security
areas.reason: Pension-management subcomponent only; very small resource share, low potential impact, no evidence of efficiency versus alternatives.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Public procurement modernization linked to business environment only loosely; resources relevant (about 20%) but impact judged low given the many areas claimed.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: General objective only minimally related; link to most listed indicators not clearly shown; pooled resources (about 20%) relevant but impact low.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Objectives directly related; SMART indicators and viable targets; relevant pooled resource share; moderate impact; innovative versus usual public management.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: General objective relevant; digitalization-focused indicators clear and viable; relevant pooled resources; impact called high yet level C assigned.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Fiscal-management objectives directly related; many SMART indicators; relevant resources; impact moderate but not high.
